+def strengthen_package_acceptance(plan: ProductPlan, *, goal_str: str = "") -> None:
+    """
+    For package product goals, replace empty/weak slice and phase acceptance with
+    an import+assert check so compile-only cannot look done.
+    """
+    from pathlib import Path

+    from lib.stdin_smoke import is_smoke_acceptance, is_weak_acceptance
+
+    goal = goal_str or plan.product_goal or plan.description
+    if not looks_like_package_goal(goal):
+        return
+
+    pkg = None
+    for item in plan.layout:
+        path = (item.path or "").replace("\\", "/")
+        if path.endswith("__init__.py"):
+            parent = Path(path).parent
+            if parent.parts:

+            if "/" in path and path.endswith(".py"):

+    if not pkg:
+        return
+
+    default = f'python -c "import {pkg}; assert {pkg}"'
+    for sl in plan.slices:
+        if is_smoke_acceptance(sl.acceptance or ""):
+            continue
+        if not (sl.acceptance or "").strip() or is_weak_acceptance(sl.acceptance):

+            else:

+        spec.acceptance = strengthened

for first product runs and small goals.

Fresh --product runs now default to an automatic MVP-only phase, while
--full-product explicitly enables MVP followed by Final. Tiny or
single-file goals receive warnings, optional rejection support, and tighter
slice budgets; extend and MVP planning also receive capped slice ranges.

Expose the behavior through CLI options and configuration settings, record
budget decisions in product logs, and allow confirmation to override the
automatic MVP-only choice. Update the operator documentation and example
configuration, and add coverage for goal detection, budget resolution, and
MVP selection.

+"""
+Product planning budget: cut LLM/planning tax for tiny goals and first playable cuts.
+
+- Warn (or reject) --product on one-file / tiny goals
+- Auto --mvp-only on first app-like product runs
+- Tighter slice min/max for tiny and extend runs
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+from typing import Optional, Tuple
+
+from lib.package_goals import looks_like_autonomous_layout_goal, looks_like_package_goal
+from lib.session_logging import log_event
+
+DEFAULT_TINY_MAX_GOAL_CHARS = 120
+
+_TINY_GOAL_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?is)^\s*("
+    r"(write|create|make|implement)\s+(a\s+)?(simple\s+|small\s+|tiny\s+)?"
+    r"(hello[\-\s]?world|script|one[\-\s]?file|single[\-\s]?file)\b.*"
+    r"|write\s+[\w./-]+\.py\b(?!.*\b(package|modules?|multi)\b).*"
+    r"|print\s+hello\b.*"
+    r")\s*$"
+)
+
+_WANTS_FULL_PRODUCT_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?is)\b("
+    r"full\s+product|final\s+shape|and\s+then\s+final|"
+    r"including\s+final|mvp\s+and\s+final|end[\-\s]?to[\-\s]?end\s+product|"
+    r"complete\s+product|production[\-\s]?ready|polish\s+and\s+ship"
+    r")\b"
+)
+
+_SINGLE_FILE_PATH_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?i)\b([\w./-]+\.(?:py|js|ts|tsx|jsx|rb|go))\b"
+)
+
+
+def _cfg_bool(config: Optional[dict], key: str, default: bool) -> bool:
+    if config is None or key not in config:
+        return default
+    return bool(config.get(key))
+
+
+def _cfg_int(config: Optional[dict], key: str, default: int) -> int:
+    try:
+        return int((config or {}).get(key, default))
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return default
+
+
+def looks_like_tiny_goal(goal: str, config: Optional[dict] = None) -> bool:
+    """True for short single-script goals where --product is usually overkill."""
+    text = (goal or "").strip()
+    if not text:
+        return False
+    if looks_like_package_goal(text) or looks_like_autonomous_layout_goal(text):
+        return False
+    max_chars = _cfg_int(config, "product_tiny_max_goal_chars", DEFAULT_TINY_MAX_GOAL_CHARS)
+    if len(text) <= max_chars and _TINY_GOAL_RE.match(text):
+        return True
+    paths = _SINGLE_FILE_PATH_RE.findall(text)
+    if len(paths) == 1 and len(text) <= max_chars and not looks_like_package_goal(text):
+        # "Write foo.py that prints X" style
+        if re.search(r"(?i)\b(write|create|make|implement)\b", text):
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
+def goal_wants_full_product(goal: str) -> bool:
+    return bool(_WANTS_FULL_PRODUCT_RE.search(goal or ""))
+
+
+def should_warn_tiny_product(goal: str, config: Optional[dict] = None) -> bool:
+    if not _cfg_bool(config, "product_warn_tiny", True):
+        return False
+    return looks_like_tiny_goal(goal, config)
+
+
+def should_reject_tiny_product(goal: str, config: Optional[dict] = None) -> bool:
+    """Optional hard reject (config product_reject_tiny)."""
+    if not _cfg_bool(config, "product_reject_tiny", False):
+        return False
+    return looks_like_tiny_goal(goal, config)
+
+
+def tiny_product_message(goal: str) -> str:
+    return (
+        "This goal looks like a tiny/single-file task. "
+        "--product adds MVP/Final planning overhead.\n"
+        "Prefer:\n"
+        f'  python app.py run-agent --goal "{goal}"\n'
+        "Or keep --product with fewer slices (auto-budget will tighten)."
+    )
+
+
+def should_auto_mvp_only(
+    goal: str,
+    config: Optional[dict] = None,
+    *,
+    fresh_product: bool = True,
+) -> bool:
+    """
+    Auto-enable MVP-only on first playable product cuts.
+
+    Skipped when:
+    - user already set product_mvp_only / product_full_product
+    - auto disabled in config
+    - continuing a product (not fresh)
+    - goal explicitly asks for full/final product
+    """
+    cfg = config or {}
+    if cfg.get("product_mvp_only"):
+        return False  # already explicit
+    if cfg.get("product_full_product"):
+        return False
+    if not _cfg_bool(cfg, "product_auto_mvp_only", True):
+        return False
+    if not fresh_product:
+        return False
+    if goal_wants_full_product(goal):
+        return False
+    # App-like / package goals benefit from MVP-first; tiny goals shouldn't use product.
+    if looks_like_tiny_goal(goal, cfg):
+        return True  # if they insisted on --product, at least stop at MVP
+    if looks_like_autonomous_layout_goal(goal) or looks_like_package_goal(goal):
+        return True
+    # Medium goals: still default to MVP-only on first run to cut tax
+    return True
+
+
+def resolve_slice_budget(
+    goal: str,
+    config: Optional[dict] = None,
+    *,
+    extend_active: bool = False,
+) -> Tuple[int, int]:
+    """
+    Return (min_slices, max_slices) for product planning.
+    """
+    cfg = config or {}
+    min_slices = _cfg_int(cfg, "product_min_slices", 2)
+    max_slices = _cfg_int(cfg, "product_max_slices", 6)
+    if min_slices < 1:
+        min_slices = 1
+    if max_slices < 1:
+        max_slices = 6
+
+    if looks_like_tiny_goal(goal, cfg):
+        min_slices = 1
+        max_slices = min(max_slices, 2)
+    elif extend_active:
+        min_slices = min(min_slices, 2)
+        max_slices = min(max_slices, 4)
+    elif _cfg_bool(cfg, "product_mvp_only", False) or should_auto_mvp_only(
+        goal, cfg, fresh_product=True
+    ):
+        # First MVP cut: don't over-slice Final into the same plan budget
+        max_slices = min(max_slices, 4)
+
+    max_slices = max(min_slices, max_slices)
+    return min_slices, max_slices
+
+
+def apply_product_budget_hints(
+    config: dict,
+    goal: str,
+    *,
+    fresh_product: bool = True,
+) -> dict:
+    """
+    Mutate/return config with auto mvp-only when appropriate.
+    Logs and prints operator hints.
+    """
+    cfg = dict(config or {})
+    if should_auto_mvp_only(goal, cfg, fresh_product=fresh_product):
+        cfg["product_mvp_only"] = True
+        cfg["_auto_mvp_only"] = True
+        print(
+            "Auto MVP-only: building the playable MVP first "

+        )
+        log_event(
+            "product.budget",
+            status="ok",
+            reason="auto_mvp_only",
+            goal=goal[:160] or None,
+        )
+    return cfg

detail.body:
Product planning can now bias toward editing an existing workspace
instead of rebuilding a fresh skeleton when source files are already
present.

This adds user controls to force extend or greenfield behavior, plus a
config setting to choose auto, always, or never. It lets product runs
and replans reuse existing code more naturally, which is important for
projects that are being continued rather than started from scratch.

The docs, example config, and tests were updated to reflect the new
planning mode and its expected behavior.

+"""
+Product extend mode: bias planning to edit an existing workspace, not rebuild it.
+
+Activated by config product_extend: auto|always|never, or CLI --extend / --greenfield.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Set
+
+from lib.repo_awareness import discover_workspace_paths
+from lib.session_logging import log_event
+from lib.stdin_smoke import infer_python_module_entrypoint
+
+MODE_AUTO = "auto"
+MODE_ALWAYS = "always"
+MODE_NEVER = "never"
+
+_SOURCE_SUFFIXES = frozenset({
+    ".py", ".js", ".ts", ".tsx", ".jsx", ".mjs", ".cjs",
+    ".go", ".rs", ".java", ".kt", ".rb", ".php",
+    ".html", ".css", ".json", ".toml", ".yaml", ".yml", ".md",
+})
+
+_CREATE_FILE_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?i)\b(create|make|add|write)\b(?:\s+\w+){0,4}\s+"
+    r"(?P<path>[\w./-]+\.(?:py|js|ts|tsx|jsx|md|json|toml|yaml|yml))"
+)
+_BARE_CREATE_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?i)\b(create|write)\s+(?:a\s+)?(?:new\s+)?(?:empty\s+)?"
+    r"(?:package\s+)?skeleton\b"
+)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ExtendSnapshot:
+    files: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    packages: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    active: bool = False
+    reason: str = ""
+
+    @property
+    def file_set(self) -> Set[str]:
+        return {f.replace("\\", "/").lstrip("./") for f in self.files}
+
+
+def product_extend_mode(config: Optional[dict]) -> str:
+    """Return auto|always|never."""
+    if (config or {}).get("product_greenfield"):
+        return MODE_NEVER
+    if (config or {}).get("product_extend_force"):
+        return MODE_ALWAYS
+    raw = str((config or {}).get("product_extend", MODE_AUTO) or MODE_AUTO).strip().lower()
+    if raw in {"always", "on", "true", "1", "yes"}:
+        return MODE_ALWAYS
+    if raw in {"never", "off", "false", "0", "no", "greenfield"}:
+        return MODE_NEVER
+    return MODE_AUTO
+
+
+def list_existing_source_files(config: Optional[dict], *, limit: int = 80) -> List[str]:
+    """Source-like paths under the code root, excluding agent bookkeeping."""
+    try:
+        paths = discover_workspace_paths(config, limit=max(limit * 2, limit))
+    except Exception:
+        return []
+    out: List[str] = []
+    for rel in paths:
+        rel_s = str(rel).replace("\\", "/").lstrip("./")
+        if rel_s.startswith(".super-duper/"):
+            continue
+        if "/__pycache__/" in f"/{rel_s}/" or rel_s.endswith(".pyc"):
+            continue
+        suffix = Path(rel_s).suffix.lower()
+        name = Path(rel_s).name
+        if suffix in _SOURCE_SUFFIXES or name in {"Makefile", "Dockerfile", "pyproject.toml"}:
+            out.append(rel_s)
+        if len(out) >= limit:
+            break
+    return out
+
+
+def snapshot_workspace_for_extend(config: Optional[dict]) -> ExtendSnapshot:
+    files = list_existing_source_files(config)
+    packages: List[str] = []
+    mod = infer_python_module_entrypoint(files)
+    if mod:
+        packages.append(mod)
+    # Also detect pkg/__init__.py packages
+    for rel in files:
+        if rel.endswith("/__init__.py"):
+            pkg = rel[: -len("/__init__.py")]
+            if pkg and "/" not in pkg and pkg not in packages:
+                packages.append(pkg)
+    return ExtendSnapshot(files=files, packages=packages)
+
+
+def should_extend_existing(config: Optional[dict], snapshot: Optional[ExtendSnapshot] = None) -> ExtendSnapshot:
+    """
+    Decide whether product planning should run in extend mode.
+    Returns an ExtendSnapshot with active=True/False and reason.
+    """
+    snap = snapshot or snapshot_workspace_for_extend(config)
+    mode = product_extend_mode(config)
+    if mode == MODE_NEVER:
+        snap.active = False
+        snap.reason = "product_extend=never"
+        return snap
+    if mode == MODE_ALWAYS:
+        snap.active = bool(snap.files)
+        snap.reason = "product_extend=always" if snap.files else "always_but_empty_workspace"
+        if not snap.files:
+            snap.active = False
+        return snap
+
+    # auto
+    if len(snap.files) >= 2:
+        snap.active = True
+        snap.reason = f"auto: {len(snap.files)} existing source files"
+        return snap
+    if snap.packages:
+        snap.active = True
+        snap.reason = f"auto: existing package(s) {', '.join(snap.packages)}"
+        return snap
+    if any(f.endswith("__main__.py") for f in snap.files):
+        snap.active = True
+        snap.reason = "auto: existing __main__.py entrypoint"
+        return snap
+    snap.active = False
+    snap.reason = "auto: no substantial existing sources"
+    return snap
+
+
+def format_extend_prompt_section(snapshot: ExtendSnapshot) -> str:
+    if not snapshot.active or not snapshot.files:
+        return ""
+    lines = [
+        "",
+        "EXTEND MODE (existing codebase — do NOT greenfield rebuild):",
+        f"Reason: {snapshot.reason}",
+    ]
+    if snapshot.packages:
+        lines.append("Existing packages: " + ", ".join(snapshot.packages))
+    lines.append("Existing files (reuse these paths):")
+    for path in snapshot.files[:40]:
+        lines.append(f"  - {path}")
+    if len(snapshot.files) > 40:
+        lines.append(f"  - … ({len(snapshot.files) - 40} more)")
+    lines.extend(
+        [
+            "EXTEND MODE rules:",
+            "- Prefer EDIT/PATCH of existing files. Do not recreate stubs that already exist.",
+            "- Keep the existing package/layout unless the goal truly requires a new file.",
+            "- layout[] must prefer the existing paths above; only add genuinely new paths.",
+            "- Slice goals for existing files must say Edit/PATCH, not Create.",
+            "- Forbidden: package-skeleton / empty-stub slices when the package already exists.",
+            "- Focus slices on the NEW behavior in the product goal.",
+            "",
+        ]
+    )
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def rewrite_goal_for_extend(goal: str, existing: Set[str]) -> str:
+    """Rewrite Create <existing-path> → Edit <path>."""
+    text = goal or ""
+    if not text or not existing:
+        return text
+
+    def repl(match: re.Match) -> str:
+        path = match.group("path").replace("\\", "/").lstrip("./")
+        if path in existing or Path(path).name in {Path(e).name for e in existing}:
+            # Prefer exact path match; fall back to basename hit only for same path end.
+            exact = path if path in existing else next(
+                (e for e in existing if e.endswith("/" + path) or e == path),
+                path,
+            )
+            return f"Edit {exact}"
+        return match.group(0)
+
+    updated = _CREATE_FILE_RE.sub(repl, text)
+    if _BARE_CREATE_RE.search(updated) and existing:
+        updated = _BARE_CREATE_RE.sub(
+            "Extend the existing package (do not recreate skeleton)",
+            updated,
+            count=1,
+        )
+    # Soft prefix once.
+    if existing and not re.search(r"(?i)\bEXTEND\b", updated):
+        updated = (
+            "EXTEND existing package: prefer PATCH; do not rewrite unrelated files. "
+            + updated
+        )
+    return updated
+
+
+def prefer_existing_layout(plan: Any, snapshot: ExtendSnapshot) -> None:
+    """Merge/prefer existing files into plan.layout."""
+    if not snapshot.active or not snapshot.files:
+        return
+    from lib.product_plan import LayoutFile
+
+    existing_entries = [
+        LayoutFile(path=p, summary="existing")
+        for p in snapshot.files[:24]
+    ]
+    proposed = list(getattr(plan, "layout", None) or [])
+    seen = {e.path for e in existing_entries}
+    for item in proposed:
+        path = getattr(item, "path", "") or ""
+        path = path.replace("\\", "/").lstrip("./")
+        if path and path not in seen:
+            existing_entries.append(LayoutFile(path=path, summary=getattr(item, "summary", "") or "new"))
+            seen.add(path)
+    plan.layout = existing_entries
+
+
+def drop_redundant_skeleton_slices(plan: Any, snapshot: ExtendSnapshot) -> int:
+    """
+    Remove MVP slices that only create files which already exist (skeleton churn).
+    Returns number of slices dropped.
+    """
+    if not snapshot.active or not snapshot.files:
+        return 0
+    existing = snapshot.file_set
+    kept = []
+    dropped = 0
+    for sl in list(getattr(plan, "slices", None) or []):
+        goal = getattr(sl, "goal", "") or ""
+        title = (getattr(sl, "title", "") or "").lower()
+        paths = [
+            m.group("path").replace("\\", "/").lstrip("./")
+            for m in _CREATE_FILE_RE.finditer(goal)
+        ]
+        skeletonish = any(
+            k in title or k in goal.lower()
+            for k in ("skeleton", "stub", "scaffold", "boilerplate", "empty package")
+        )
+        if paths and skeletonish and all(
+            p in existing or any(e.endswith("/" + p) or e == p for e in existing)
+            for p in paths
+        ):
+            dropped += 1
+            continue
+        # Whole-slice "create package" with no new paths when package exists
+        if skeletonish and snapshot.packages and not paths:
+            dropped += 1
+            continue
+        kept.append(sl)
+    if dropped and kept:
+        plan.slices = kept
+    elif dropped and not kept:
+        # Never drop everything; keep original
+        return 0
+    return dropped
+
+
+def apply_extend_bias_to_plan(plan: Any, snapshot: ExtendSnapshot) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Mutate plan for extend mode; return stats."""
+    stats = {"rewritten_goals": 0, "dropped_slices": 0, "layout_preferred": False}
+    if not snapshot.active:
+        return stats
+    prefer_existing_layout(plan, snapshot)
+    stats["layout_preferred"] = True
+    existing = snapshot.file_set
+    for sl in getattr(plan, "slices", None) or []:
+        old = getattr(sl, "goal", "") or ""
+        new = rewrite_goal_for_extend(old, existing)
+        if new != old:
+            sl.goal = new
+            stats["rewritten_goals"] += 1
+    stats["dropped_slices"] = drop_redundant_skeleton_slices(plan, snapshot)
+    if snapshot.packages:
+        rec = (
+            f"Extend existing package(s) {', '.join(snapshot.packages)}; "
+            "do not recreate stubs"
+        )
+        reqs = list(getattr(plan.mvp, "recommendations", None) or [])
+        if rec not in reqs:
+            plan.mvp.recommendations = [rec] + reqs
+    log_event(
+        "product.extend",
+        status="ok",
+        reason=snapshot.reason,
+        files=len(snapshot.files),
+        rewritten_goals=stats["rewritten_goals"],
+        dropped_slices=stats["dropped_slices"],
+        packages=",".join(snapshot.packages) or None,
+    )
+    return stats
+
+
+def announce_extend_mode(snapshot: ExtendSnapshot) -> None:
+    if not snapshot.active:

`--extend` to force edit/patch planning
`--greenfield` to ignore existing files and rebuild from scratch

spine.summary: Product planning now detects existing source files and can favor extending them instead of rebuilding from scratch. Users can control this behavior with automatic, forced extend, or greenfield modes, while plans are adjusted to reuse existing files and avoid redundant skeleton work.
